messages:
incident-bot: Scheduled maintenance notice: GPU host kernel patching on 2026-06-10 01:00-03:00 UTC. Expected rolling reboots of model workers. Please acknowledge.

alice (SRE): @channel ack. Risk note: rolling restarts -> KV cache warmup may add 10-25s latency on affected workers. Will watch p95/p99.

dmitri (oncall): I'm on pager for the window. I'll take the 00:45 handoff. If anyone needs to swap, respond here before 00:40 UTC.

ben (support): Drafting customer notice. Sharing for product review: @carla

carla (product): Quick ask: include "no persistent customer data will be changed" and a rollback blurb. Also route critical replies to #support-escalations.

ben (support): Updated customer blurb below:

---
Planned maintenance: 2026-06-10 01:00-03:00 UTC
Impact: You may observe short, intermittent increases in latency and a small number of retries / 503s while model workers restart.
What we’re doing: Applying a kernel security patch to GPU hosts with controlled rolling reboots of model-serving nodes.
Action for customers: No action required. If you have critical jobs during this window, consider rescheduling. Please implement retries with exponential backoff.
Contact: support@redwood.ai or DM @ben for urgent concerns.
Notes: No persistent customer data will be modified. We have a rollback plan if smoke tests fail.
---

carla (product): Approved. Add a line noting Dedicated capacity in us-east-1 may see transient throughput drops; reserved slots are preserved.

alice (SRE): Ops brief checklist:
- Pre: validate controller replicas, drain low-priority workloads
- Patch cycle: patch host -> reboot kernel -> verify kubelet + controller -> run smoke tests -> return to pool
- Post: run KV pre-seed job, ramp synthetic traffic, confirm latency baselines

dmitri (oncall): Pre-check scheduled at 00:20 UTC. @maria please prep smoke script and S3 artifact upload.

maria (ops): Smoke script: `scripts/gpu_smoke.sh`. Artifacts to `s3://prod-smoke/artifacts/$(date +%s)-gpu.json`. I'll be on standby.

incident-bot: Reminder set: pre-check 00:20 UTC, maintenance start 01:00 UTC.

ben (support): Status page start draft (to post at start):

---
We are performing planned security updates to GPU hosts. You may see brief latency spikes and occasional retries while workers restart. ETA for completion: 03:00 UTC.
---

alice (SRE): One more: schedule small KV prime on nodes after reboot to reduce warmup impact.

carla (product): Good. Also coordinate PS to notify top-tier customers.

maria (ops): Pre-check done 00:22 UTC: controllers green, drains completed for non-critical jobs.

incident-bot: Maintenance START at 01:00 UTC. Posting to status page and sending customer notifications.

ben (support): Sent notifications and updated status page: "Planned maintenance in progress. You may experience retries and higher latency. ETA 03:00 UTC."

alice (SRE): First batch of hosts patched and rebooted. Observed worker warmup causing ~15-22s p95 latency on some endpoints; autoscaler holding. No sustained error rate increases yet.

dmitri (oncall): Noted a brief spike of 503s affecting ~0.7% of traffic between 01:10-01:14 UTC. Opening temporary incident marker to track customer reports. Tagging #support-escalations.

ben (support): Received report from one customer about batch retries — advised exponential backoff and confirmed we're monitoring.

maria (ops): Progress: 9/30 hosts updated in us-east-1. Smoke tests passing within 2-4 minutes post-boot.

alice (SRE): Enabled KV pre-seed job for subsequent nodes; expecting warmup drop to ~3-6s. Applying in next batch.

incident-bot: Status update 01:40 UTC: maintenance ongoing; minor customer impact observed. Next automated update at 02:10 UTC or on status change.

ben (support): Escalation DM template for affected customers:

Hi <CustomerName>,

We’re performing planned GPU host maintenance and observed transient retries impacting requests around 01:10 UTC. We have applied mitigations and continue to monitor. If you see persistent failures, reply here and we'll escalate immediately.

Thanks,
Redwood Support

carla (product): Template approved. Make sure PS notified top accounts.

dmitri (oncall): Mid-window note: I need to hand off final 12 minutes to @alice (stepping out 02:48-03:05). @alice can you take completion posts and verify dashboards at 03:00 and 03:10?

alice (SRE): Yep, I'll handle end-of-window checks and post completion.

maria (ops): Final batches underway; applying remaining patches in groups of 4 to maintain capacity.

incident-bot: Maintenance COMPLETE at 03:03 UTC. All hosts patched. Posting completion update.

ben (support): Posted completion to status page and emailed subscribed customers: "Maintenance complete. Services restored. Contact support if you see regressions."

carla (product): Follow-ups: add KV pre-seed as a standard step in maintenance runbook and create RFC to evaluate permanent pre-seed for rolling restarts. I'll own the RFC.

dmitri (oncall): Closing temporary incident marker. Will add runbook notes to on-call log.

alice (SRE): Post-maintem notes: root cause of customer-facing retries = KV cache cold starts on worker spin-up. Mitigation (KV pre-seed) reduced subsequent warmup. No data loss. Schedule perf testing before next window.

ben (support): Collected customer replies; no escalations beyond initial retry reports. Forwarded to PS.

carla (product): Thanks all. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
